name: warehouse-reorder
prompt: In package warehouse.stock, reorder the parameters of Ledger.transfer to transfer(to, from, qty), the order the company's other ledgers use, and update every call. What the ledger does must not change.

name: warehouse-inline
prompt: In class warehouse.gates.Yard, inline the helper methods both, either and within at every call, and delete them. What the yard does must not change.

name: warehouse-rename
prompt: In class warehouse.pricing.Pricing, rename the static field margin to markup, the name the rest of the company uses. The prices must not change.

name: warehouse-dedupe
prompt: The probe methods of the ten sensors in warehouse.alerts.Sensors do nearly the same thing. Remove the duplication: make them call one static method. What alerts they add must not change.
